items.quote: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:
items.claim: When Israelites enter the promised land and harvest crops, they must bring a sheaf of firstfruits to the priest
items.mechanism: upon coming to the land and reaping harvest

items.quote: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you:
items.claim: The priest shall wave the sheaf before the LORD for acceptance on behalf of the people

items.quote: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.
items.claim: The sheaf waving ritual occurs on the day following the sabbath
